title: IEEE Publication: Hardware Trojan Detection
text: Sai published a peer-reviewed IEEE conference paper titled 'Hardware Trojan Detection with Machine Learning and Power Side-Channels: A Post-Deployment Analysis' at IEEE CNS 2025. By analyzing power consumption data from an Artix FPGA running AES-128, the model achieved 98% detection accuracy while reducing computational costs and improving noise robustness. Co-authored with Ashwin Koshy John, Jaya Dofe, and Jai Gopal Pandey.
